Description: UGA, GHS-DUG grid L1 classification. Population and SDG indicators by Degree of Urbanisation​ (DEGURBA) [WorldPop R2025A v1]

AREA_OR_POINT: Area
properties.description:
The dataset provides high-resolution geospatial outputs on degree of urbanisation, available for download in GeoTIFF format at 1 km resolution and presented in the Mollweide equal-area projection (ESRI:54009, WGS84 ellipsoid).

WorldPop Global2 R2025A population data were used together with the GHSL GHS-DUG tool (v6.8) to produce Degree of Urbanisation classes.

Geospatial output data consist of several files covering different urbanisation classes; please refer to the tool documentation for detailed file specifications, processing parameters, and usage guidelines.
properties.coordinate_reference_system:name: ESRI:54009
properties.coordinate_reference_system:accuracy: Based on World Geodetic System 1984 ensemble (EPSG:6326), which has a limited accuracy of at best 2 meters.
properties.coordinate_reference_system:citation:
Bondarenko M., Zhang W., Tejedor-Garavito N., Nosatiuk B., Tatem A., Sorichetta A..Degree of Urbanisation classes using WorldPop Global2 R2025A population data with theGHSL GHS-DUG tool. DEGURBA Project - Funded by European Commission. WorldPop -School of Geography and Environmental Science, University of Southampton 2026. 

 DOI:10.5258/SOTON/WP00879
